Callout.Name: Vandalism - Ranger Cabin
Callout.Message: Damage to a ranger cabin overnight.

Script.Line: The door has been kicked in and nothing has been taken.
There is nothing in there to take, which is rather the point.
They came in, had a look and left.

Lines.Approach: The door has been put in and there is nothing worth taking in there.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
